verdict.rationale: Netlify's first-party marketing says it offers built-in file storage. A code sample shows a named blob store, getStore("file-uploads"), being used for uploads, so the core of the story is covered by the product itself. The evidence is thin marketing snippets rather than in-depth docs. Missing for 10: detailed storage docs (write/read API, size limits, persistence guarantees, access control), and independent or hands-on corroboration of storing user uploads.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist user-generated uploads using built-in object storage

citations.quote: Add instant databases and file storage
